original_evidence.redaction: API-key fields/string occurrences and all search_metadata including its URLs removed from the private 0600 response copy; original raw SHA calculated before transformation.

implementation.economic_offers: Unchanged byte-for-byte for the same response and clock; no photo field is added to prices/offers/snapshots.
implementation.view_only_cache: Safe property images only, exact (offer_id, property_token), LRU256 entries, six-hour TTL, at mostfive deduplicated images per entry.
implementation.source_identity: DTO sourceSERPAPI with hotelId=sourceHotelId=the exact property_token returned under that offer. Conflicting/foreign image identifiers, offer IDs or hotel bindings yield no actual photo.
implementation.url_policy: Separate exact lh3.googleusercontent.com HTTPS grass-cs/grass-proxy paths; LiteAPI URL policy is unchanged. No image download/proxy or arbitrary URL fetch.
implementation.existing_plan_endpoint: Owner-bound saved/partial GET S/media reuses the same DTO, up to20 cache-only SerpApi hotels, existing LiteAPI fetch limitunchanged.
implementation.standalone_endpoint: Existing asynchronous live/search result adds optional live_media.items[].media alongside unchanged live_offers; offer_id joins presentation to the owned result.
implementation.miss_policy: Missing/expired/evicted/restarted cache returns a placeholder without any network lookup; a new ordinary search can refill the process-local cache.

earlier_related.scope: Providers/media/price-media/standalone tests before the final capacity256 and Serp presentation20 bounds adjustment; final whole R21 is separate.

verification.economics: Nonempty assembled component/source_snapshots and full snapshot_hash stay equal before/after presentation; compare_plans.requires_new_confirmation=False. LIVE_INDICATIVE/price/availability flags unchanged.
verification.ownership: Saved-plan API and asynchronous run reject missing/foreign owner tokens. Media mutations operate on views/deep copies only.
negative_controls: Dedup/photo/packet bounds, two twenty-offer cache retention
verification.independent_readonly_peer: No blocking finding reported; economic snapshot separation, sidecar access and source-specific URL policy reviewed.

limitations: Whole frozen R21 and native/archive rollout remain separate Root steps.
The repair was replayed against the same captured real response; no new post-patch SerpApi request was issued.
Process-local photo cache is not durable across restart. Cache misses never manufacture alternative images or cause extra paid/free searches.
Returned search photographs do not establish room identity, copyright ownership, current availability, tariff equivalence or a supplier booking.
The separate original two-read response and its photo gap remain historical evidence; it was not silently replaced with this captured-response phase.
